skills.name: Build
skills.description: Runs the project's build the way the project does and reports the result. Use when a task or check needs a build.

skills.name: Test
skills.description: Runs the project's tests the way the project does and reports the result. Use after changing behavior or when a task asks for tests.

skills.name: Lint
skills.description: Runs the project's lint and type checks the way the project does and reports the result. Use before handing off a change or when a task asks for lint.

skills.name: Validate
skills.description: Checks that a change is ready by running the build, test and lint skills in order and reporting each result. Use before pushing, opening or updating a pull request, or calling a task done.

skills.name: Post result to parent
skills.description: Sends a finished result or review verdict to the agent that started you, using the Clubhouse message_parent tool. Use when you are a helper agent and your task or review is done.

skills.name: Post result to the board
skills.description: Posts a finished result or review verdict on the Clubhouse group project board with the post_bulletin tool, in the channel where the work was assigned or the requester's inbox. Use when your task or review in a group project is done.

skills.name: Post result to the pull request
skills.description: Posts a review verdict or a finished task's outcome as a comment on its pull request on GitHub or Azure DevOps, starting with Approve or Reject. Use when you reviewed a pull request, or finished work that has one.

skills.name: Post result
skills.description: Delivers a finished result or review verdict to the right place, choosing between the parent agent, the Clubhouse group project board, the pull request and the conversation. Use when a task or review is done and its result needs reporting.

templates.name: Orchestrator
templates.description: Plans work and runs helpers to do it.

templates.name: Group Project Lead
templates.description: Coordinates other agents through a group project.

templates.name: Quality Assurance (pull request)
templates.description: Reviews a pull request and posts its verdict as a comment on it. Never merges.

templates.name: Quality Assurance (group project)
templates.description: Reviews changes assigned on a group project board and posts its verdict there.

templates.name: Developer (Full Merge)
templates.description: Builds features and merges when checks pass.

templates.name: Developer (No Merge)
templates.description: Builds features and opens a PR for review.

templates.name: Product Owner
templates.description: Turns ideas and bugs into clear, detailed issues.

templates.name: Researcher
templates.description: Investigates and reports. Does not change code.

templates.name: Helper
templates.description: A generic helper: one task, then report back.

templates.name: Developer helper
templates.description: A helper that implements one task and pushes a branch.

templates.name: Research helper
templates.description: A helper that investigates one question and reports cited findings.

templates.name: QA helper
